titulo: Como si + hubiera + participle = as if (it) had...
subtitulo: Me miró como si hubiera visto un fantasma.
regla: Como si always takes the subjunctive. For something that would have happened before: como si + pluperfect subjunctive (hubiera / hubiese + participle): Me miró como si hubiera visto un fantasma. For something simultaneous: como si + imperfect subjunctive (como si fuera).

bloques.texto: _as if (someone) had..._: the imagined action happened **before**.
**Never** the indicative after **como si** in this sense (English uses the indicative: _as if he had seen_).
Compare: **como si fuera** (now, simultaneous) vs **como si hubiera sido** (before).

lista.es: Elisa me miraba ==como si hubiera hecho== algo malo.
lista.en: Elisa looked at me as if I'd done something wrong.

lista.es: Se portaba ==como si nunca hubiera roto== un plato.
lista.en: She acted as if she'd never broken a plate (as if butter wouldn't melt in her mouth).

lista.es: Sentí algo raro, ==como si hubiese estado== ahí antes.
lista.en: I felt something strange, as if I'd been there before.

lista.es: Habla ==como si hubiera vivido== toda su vida en Oaxaca.
lista.en: He talks as if he'd lived in Oaxaca all his life.

lista.es: Se fue ==como si no hubiera pasado== nada.
lista.en: He left as if nothing had happened.
